notes.title: Indigo Park - YouTooz Plushies!
notes.content:
It's official, y'all!

The Mollie and Rambley Indigo Park plushes by youtooz are up and available NOW!
This is Mollie's first ever piece of official merch, and I'm super excited for you guys to get ahold of these!
Head over to Youtooz's website as once they're gone, they're gone!

GET THEM NOW! 
https://youtooz.com/collections/indigo-park

notes.title: V 1.0.2
notes.content:
We've been prepping for a bigger update that will tackle a lot of the major bugs and issues, but in the mean time, we had a few smaller changes we wanted to make. 

V1.0.2 fixes a handful of smaller bugs (there's still a lot more we have on the list to fix). 

Most notably, we've made a change to the gift shop to prevent players from softlocking if they interacted with the scanner too quickly. 

We've also replaced the death screen art and made some corrections to the credits sequence.

notes.title: V 1.0.1
notes.content:
We've had a super successful launch and we can't thank you enough for it. 
V 1.0.1 attempts to correct the texture blur issue that many of you were experiencing. In testing, this has now been fixed, but we won't really know until it's out there. 

We also implemented a slight change to the first gear pickup that should prevent the game from crashing when you pick it up. 

Thank you all for your understanding, we'll have more updates coming soon to address the many issues and bugs in the game. <3
